svg.title: Companion library
svg.desc: Organize instruments and projects locally on your computer.

g.text: Organize instruments and projects locally on your computer.
Collections, tags, favorites, rename, duplicate, move and Trash/Undo.
PC library items are separate from the unit’s onboard banks and projects.
Import/export native FMER data and standard DX7 FM voices or 32-voice banks.
Actual Companion browser capture / example library / no unit connected
